text: Notice of Fee Adjustment. Pursuant to Section 4(b) of the Residents' Agreement, the monthly service fee shall increase by 8% with effect from 1 March. Residents who wish to contest the adjustment must submit a written objection to the Estates Office no later than 14 February. Objections received after that date will not be considered. Payment of the adjusted fee is required regardless of any pending objection. The Estates Office may waive the adjustment in exceptional circumstances, as determined at its sole discretion.

raw.summary: This is a notice that the monthly service fee for residents goes up by 8% from 1 March. If you want to contest the increase, you must send a written objection to the Estates Office by 14 February. You still have to pay the higher fee while an objection is pending. The Estates Office can waive the increase in exceptional circumstances, and it alone decides what counts.
key_points: The monthly service fee increases by 8% from 1 March.
Objections must be in writing and reach the Estates Office by 14 February.
Objections received after that date will not be considered.
You must pay the new fee even while an objection is pending.
The Estates Office may waive the increase, at its own discretion.
